name: gitmir-local
description: Local dashboard for running Claude Code across projects: models each product from the real code, turns any part of that model into an exact task, and verifies the work before calling it done.

comments.dependencies: Empty, and staying that way. The diagram renderer is written for this project and the fonts are vendored under vendor/, so the tool has no supply chain to trust and works offline.
comments.devDependencies: typescript is for `npm run typecheck` only. Nothing is installed to RUN this — Node executes the .ts files directly, so `git clone && node server.ts` still needs nothing.
comments.engines: Node strips TypeScript types natively from 22.18. Node 18 and 20 are both past end of life.
comments.bin: Deliberately absent. `npm i -g` would put this under node_modules, and Node refuses to strip TypeScript types from there (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING) — so the install would look fine and the server would die on its first import. install.sh clones instead, which is why it exists.
